facts.text: The lodge is 10km north of the coastal marine town of Kaikoura, on the east coast of New Zealand's South Island.
facts.excerpt: The lodge is 10km north of the coastal marine town of Kaikoura, situated on the east coast of the South Island of New Zealand.

facts.text: The lodge is part of a working deer farm.
facts.excerpt: because we are part of a working deer farm

facts.text: The Tree Houses sit 10 metres (30 feet) above ground in the canopy of a native kanuka grove.
facts.excerpt: The Tree Houses sit 30 feet / 10 metres above ground, in the canopy of a native Kanuka grove

facts.text: Tree House stays include deep-soaking baths with mountain or ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Deep-soaking baths with mountain or ocean views

facts.text: Tree Houses have a fireplace and underfloor heating for year-round comfort.
facts.excerpt: Fireplace and underfloor heating for year-round comfort

facts.text: The Family Tree House has two ensuite bedrooms, an Upper and a Lower Branch, connected by an internal staircase.
facts.excerpt: the Family Tree House consists of two ensuite bedrooms, an Upper and a Lower Branch, connected by an internal staircase

facts.text: The three-bedroom Olive House was once home to the estate's olive press.
facts.excerpt: This three-bedroom house, once home to our olive press, weaves together elegant spaces where memories are meant to be made.

facts.text: The Olive House has sweeping views of the Kaikoura mountains and the Pacific Ocean.
facts.excerpt: sweeping views of the Kaikōura mountains and Pacific Ocean

facts.text: Lodge Suites have a separate living area with a stone fireplace and panoramic views of the Kaikoura mountains and deer paddocks.
facts.excerpt: offer a separate living area with a stone fireplace, providing a cosy retreat with panoramic views of the Kaikōura mountains and deer paddocks

facts.text: Lodge Suites have a deep two-person Japanese soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Deep two-person Japanese soaking tub

facts.text: The Hapuku Room has private stairway access to the pool area.
facts.excerpt: Private stairway access to the pool area

facts.text: All stays include a three-course dinner and gourmet breakfast each day.
facts.excerpt: All stays include a three course dinner and gourmet breakfast each day.

facts.text: Guided stargazing is included for all guests.
facts.excerpt: Guided stargazing is included for all guests staying at Hapuku Lodge.

facts.text: The lodge is situated in the Dark Sky Sanctuary.
facts.excerpt: Situated in the Dark Sky Sanctuary, the night sky reveals a brilliant display of stars, planets, and constellations.

facts.text: The lodge has a heated outdoor mineral lap pool, spa pool, cold plunge and sauna, free for all guests.
facts.excerpt: The lodge has a heated outdoor mineral lap pool, spa pool, cold plunge and sauna, which are free for all of our guests to use.

facts.text: From the sauna, the view drifts across the deer paddock to the Kaikoura mountains.
facts.excerpt: Step into stillness as warmth surrounds you and your gaze drifts across the deer paddock to the Kaikōura mountains beyond.

facts.text: The spa offers treatments to guests and visitors by appointment.
facts.excerpt: Spa is open to guests and visitors by appointment

facts.text: The signature Pinda Massage uses heated cotton pouches filled with sea salt, herbs and essential oils.
facts.excerpt: Heated cotton pouches filled with sea salt, herbs, and essential oils are used to massage the body

facts.text: A facial uses local glacial clay, manuka oil and organic botanicals.
facts.excerpt: A nourishing facial with local glacial clay, mānuka oil, and organic botanicals to cleanse, brighten and hydrate.

facts.text: In the secluded secret garden, guests can book a private hot tub or play garden games as the sun sets over the seaward Kaikoura ranges.
facts.excerpt: Book a private hot tub, or enjoy garden games as the sun sets over the seaward Kaikōura mountain ranges.

facts.text: Quiet lanes past deer paddocks lead to the rugged coastline a kilometre from the Lodge.
facts.excerpt: follow quiet lanes past deer paddocks to the rugged coastline just a kilometre from the Lodge

facts.text: Mountain bikes are available free of charge to all guests.
facts.excerpt: Mountain bikes available free of charge to explore to all guests.

facts.text: A daily guided Nature Tour is offered, and guests can wander the native gardens, olive grove and kitchen garden.
facts.excerpt: Join our daily guided Nature Tour, or wander through the native gardens, olive grove, and kitchen garden

facts.text: Ingredients come from the lodge's organic kitchen garden, neighbouring farms and the Pacific.
facts.excerpt: Ingredients are sourced from our organic kitchen garden, neighbouring farms, and the wild waters of the Pacific.

facts.text: The shared guest lounge has a fireplace and floor-to-ceiling views of the Kaikoura Ranges.
facts.excerpt: The shared guest lounge offers plush seating, a fireplace, and floor-to-ceiling views of the Kaikōura Ranges.

facts.text: Rooms are not equipped for in-suite dining; all meals are served in the restaurant or courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Our rooms are not equipped for in-suite dining. All meals are served in the lodges restaurant or courtyard (weather permitting)

facts.text: The nearest international airport is Christchurch, about a 2 hour 35 minute drive away.
facts.excerpt: The nearest international airport is Christchurch, which is 197km and an approximate 2hr 35 minute drive

facts.text: The lodge has an on-site helipad; all landings and take-offs must be pre-advised.
facts.excerpt: Yes, we have a helipad on-site. Please note that we must be pre-advised fo all landings and take offs.

facts.text: Farm tours are not offered and guests may not enter the deer paddocks.
facts.excerpt: Unfortunately we are unable to offer farm tours and guests are not permitted to enter the paddocks.

facts.text: A strict no-pet policy applies anywhere on site.
facts.excerpt: we must adhere to a strict no pet policy anywhere on site

facts.text: Sperm whales are present off Kaikoura year-round, with seasonal visits from humpbacks and orca.
facts.excerpt: Sperm whales are present year-round, with seasonal visits from humpbacks, orca, and more.

facts.text: Fur seals can be spotted at Mangamaunu beach and Ohau Point near the Lodge.
facts.excerpt: You can also spot them at Mangamaunu beach and Ohau Point near the Lodge.

facts.text: Complimentary bikes and helmets are provided for families.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary bikes and helmets

facts.text: Every room has a complimentary minibar.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar in your room
